messages:
sara: Promo paused by deploy-bot. CI shows checksum mismatch for artifacts served from CDN edge(s). Some agents fetched old/partial objects during a recent edge purge.
deploy-bot: Auto-pause triggered by policy 'artifact_integrity'. Holding promo.
ci-bot: 11/24 agents reported checksum drift for `webapp-bundle-2026-03-22.tar.gz`. Logs show 200 but content-length varies; likely stale edge or partial fetch.
mike: We ran an emergency CDN purge at 02:45 UTC which may have left inconsistent caches across POPs. Ops, any idea?
ops-lee: Confirmed partial invalidation on a few POPs due to rate-limited purge API. We're revalidating and forcing origin fetch for affected keys. ETA 20m.
anya: Short options: 1) pin to last-green and abort promo, 2) retry fetches after forcing origin-bypass in CI, 3) reupload artifacts and retry. Recommend (2) + origin-bypass header to avoid stale edge.
sara: I prefer (2) to minimize customer impact. Can we hotflip CI fetch step to add `cache-control: no-cache` / origin-bypass and rerun a canary?
ci-bot: Patch branch `ci/force-origin-fetch` created. Manual trigger required.
deploy-bot: During change window, manual hotflip needs 2 release-council approvals.
release-council: Approved emergency hotflip to force origin fetch for canary only. If canary fails, escalate to pin to last-green.
mike: Triggering canary job 11021 limited to 3 shards. Link: https://ci.internal/builds/11021
ci-bot: Canary started. Monitoring fetch headers and checksums.
ops-lee: Forcing origin fetch and purging stale POPs as part of remediation. Watching propagation.
ci-bot: Canary result: 3/3 shards fetched from origin and checksums match. No truncation.
sara: Good. deploy-bot: Manual resume allowed per council after canary. Requirement: include release note and postmortem about CDN purge rate limits.
release-council: Also add an operational play to monitor malformed content-length on fetch and treat as integrity alert.
anya: Drafting release-note: "Promotion paused briefly due to CDN edge cache inconsistency after emergency purge; CI retried artifacts forcing origin fetch and verified checksums. Promotion resumed. Follow-up: adjust purge flow and add integrity alert for content-length variance."
sara: Updating promo ticket: status -> resumed; add follow-up task PI-4599. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
